name: Bosnia and Herzegovina

flag.description: A blue field with a large yellow right-angled triangle near the fly side, and a diagonal line of white five-pointed stars (seven whole and two halved at the edges) running along its long side.
flag.symbolism: The triangle's three points stand for the three constituent peoples (Bosniaks, Croats and Serbs) and roughly echo the country's shape; the stars and blue recall the flag of Europe.

hook: A yellow triangle chased by a diagonal line of white stars that run off the edges: Bosnia's blue flag has no map or arc of stars like Kosovo's.
trivia: The flag was chosen by the international High Representative, Carlos Westendorp, after local politicians could not agree, and introduced in time for the 1998 Nagano Winter Olympics.
The half-stars at the top and bottom are meant to suggest the line of stars continues infinitely.
